_parhne_wale_ke_liye: Ali Mobile Shop Toolkit — raaston ki file.
YE ASAL COPY HAI. App ise yahan se NAHI parhti — app GitHub par rakhi
copy parhti hai, din mein aik dafa:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/manan-989/ali-shop-raaste/main/raaste.json
Yani tarteeb ye hai: yahan badlein -> GitHub par upload karein -> har
customer ki app agle din khud utaar legi. Nayi exe banane ki zarurat
NAHI. Jaldi chahiye to app ke 'Raaste' safhe par 'Abhi dekho' dabayein.
App teen jagah dekhti hai, isi tarteeb mein:
1. GitHub wali file (sab se nayi)
2. pichhli dafa utri hui copy (internet band ho to)
3. exe ke andar likhe purane pate (ye kabhi khali nahi hote)
Ehtiyat: ye JSON hai. Har line ke aakhir mein comma hota hai, siwaye
aakhri line ke. Agar comma ghalat hua to app is file ko chhor kar
apne andar wale purane pate par chali jayegi — kuch tootega nahi.
Jo khane app abhi parhti hai, sirf wo ye hain:
version, updated,
moviebox: apiHosts, siteHosts, bffPath, pagePath,
endpoints.search, endpoints.download, headers.x-request-lang,
quality:  poochhne_ki_hadd_mb
Baqi sab likhai samajhne ke liye hai — app unhein chhorh deti hai.

moviebox._note: Pehla pata jo chale, wohi le liya jayega. Naya pata SAB SE UPAR likhein.
_endpoints_note: 'search' POST hai aur sirf mehmaan parche (JWT) se chalti hai.
'download' GET hai — asli link isi se milta hai.
Purani '/subject/detail' ab band ho chuki hai (404 aata hai). Season
ki tafseel ab detail page ke andar se nikalti hai — neeche dekhein.
moviebox._siteHosts_note: Title ka apna page aur link maangne wali call — dono isi pate par.
_pagePath_note: SAB SE AHEM LINE. Har title — movie ho ya drama — isi '/movies/' raste
par milta hai ('/tv/' aur '/detail/' par 404 hai).
Ye pata do kaam karta hai:
1. Season aur episode ki list isi page ke andar milti hai.
2. Link maangte waqt 'Referer' mein YEHI pata jata hai.
Agar Referer mein sirf 'moviebox.ph/' bhej dein to site kehti hai
'koi file nahi' — halanke file mojood hoti hai. Ye ghalti pakarne
mein bohat waqt laga tha, is liye yahan likh di gayi hai.
_seasonSource_note: Season ki list kisi API se nahi aati. Detail page ke andar
'__NUXT_DATA__' wala dabba hota hai, us mein ye shakal hai:
resource -> seasons[] -> { se, maxEp, resolutions[{ resolution }] }
Us dabbe mein har qeemat aik doosre ka pata (index) de kar juri hoti hai.

quality._note: Dukaandaar jo quality chunta hai wo 'chaha hua' hai. Agar kisi episode par wo mojood na ho to ye seerhi chalti hai.
_seerhi_matlab: 480 chuna magar 480 nahi          -> 360 (neeche wali, chhoti file)
in mein se koi nahi               -> ruk kar poochhega: 'Ep 7 sirf 1080p mein hai — 1.34 GB. Karein?'
quality._hadd_note: Is se bari file par hamesha poochha jayega, chahe seerhi mein aa bhi jaye. 0 likhein to kabhi nahi poochhega.

_aage_ke_liye._note: Ye khane abhi khali hain. Zarurat pare to yahin bhar diye jayenge — exe ko haath lagaye baghair.
